integrity: The global singular locus is proved from the line-hyperplane incidence model, while the ordinary-double-point normal form is derived on an eigenbasis chart and cross-checked against the published Example 5.5 patch. The symbolic replay verifies local algebra only and is not used as a substitute for the global proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the type-A codimension-one Hessenberg variety with \(S=\operatorname{diag}(1,1,-1,-1)\) and \(h=(3,4,4,4)\); no classification for other semisimple spectra or Hessenberg functions, and no resolution or global canonical calculation is claimed.
title: Two quadric singular strata in a semisimple codimension-one Hessenberg fivefold
